# rind on pixel9pro: Google Pixel 9 Pro (Tensor G4)

Three rounds on a Google Pixel 9 Pro (Tensor G4, aarch64) in Termux on Android 17, at [kixel-ai/rind `d6ca9a75`](https://github.com/kixel-ai/rind/commit/d6ca9a756d3d1e71489e61e44c04f33c3c893589), on 2026-11-13 from 10:09 AM to 12:14 PM America/Los_Angeles (run clocks 18:09:50 to 20:14:21 UTC).

The suite used this checkout's unmodified `admin/bench-report run` through a Python wrapper (`scripts/host-run-android.py`), not `cargo xtask pixel-run`. The binaries were built on the phone. The run was not pinned to one core. Each published time is the median of the three rounds' criterion estimates (`pixel9pro.json`, schema 1, each run's estimate in `runs_ns`). `ns_low` and `ns_high` are the minimum and maximum of those three estimates (`spread_is: "runs"`). [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) lists every run, [facts.txt](facts.txt) the hardware, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) how the phone was run.

- Board: Google Pixel 9 Pro, Termux on Android 17 (API 37, build CP3A.261005.005)
- CPU: Google Tensor G4 (1× Cortex-X4, 3× Cortex-A720, 4× Cortex-A520), aarch64. Snapshots show `cpu_online` 0-7; bench-report recorded 7 logical CPUs
- OS: Android 17 (API 37, build CP3A.261005.005, Linux 17)
- Toolchain: rustc 1.96.0 (ac68faa20 2026-05-25), cargo 1.96.0, both built from a source tarball
- OpenSSL linked: OpenSSL 3.6.3 9 Jun 2026
- rind-cpuid: aes, dit, neon, pmull, sha2, sha3. The Tensor G4 also has SVE2; that is not a rind-cpuid key at this pin
- Libraries refused for missing CPU features: none
- Criterion: `--noplot --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 3`
- Pin: none (a benchmark could land on an X4, an A720, or an A520 core)
- Power: on AC the whole suite; battery still fell 27% → 22%, temperature 27.1 → 35.0 °C
- Validation: 91 of 91 host-kat checks passed; `cargo test --release -p rind` 814 passed, 0 failed
- `build_cost`: not measured (skipped by the host-run wrapper)
- Noisy (bench-report's flag, any run): no

## Gaps

Each operation where another library is more than 10% faster than rind, by rind's rule (OpenSSL counts), with its reason from [gaps.toml](gaps.toml). `cargo xtask host-report` refuses a gap without an entry and an entry that covers no gap.

| Operations | rind over the fastest | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `rustls-bulk/chacha20poly1305`, `chacha20poly1305/16KB` | 1.24× OpenSSL; 1.32× OpenSSL | OpenSSL uses the Tensor G4's SVE2 ChaCha path. This unmodified upstream kixel-ai/rind d6ca9a75 build does not; rind-cpuid at this pin reports aes, pmull, sha2, sha3, neon, and dit, but not SVE2. The same gap appears in rustls bulk ChaCha20-Poly1305. rind is even with ring and aws-lc-rs on these rows. |
